[higherdestiny] Not really the same category at all.
Ubiquiti offers 24/7 enterprise-level local recording, hard wired POE interface, optical zoom, and full interoperability with other devices within the unifi environment (such as using line-crossing from another camera to trigger the PTZ).
Sure, you can save a few dollars and stick up a gawdy solar powered thing that only records events, defaults to 15fps (and maxes out at 20fps), and only to SD card or a single drive hub, and is susceptible to WiFi jamming or simply shutting down on a dark day.
Some prefer to invest in an ecosystem that offers storage scalability, power supply redundancy, and high availability.
All the flashy features aren't worth a thing if you miss the one split second that needed to be captured. This is where Ubiquiti wins.
